name: C1406 Czar

origin.basis: CST is the Cheng Shin (正新) brand of Taiwan's Cheng Shin Rubber; China listings give the brand as CST/正新.

manufacturing.basis: The retailer page does not state the factory.

positioning: CST's low-cost wire-bead slick road clincher with an EPS puncture layer.
weight_basis: The retailer gives both 310 g and 240 g for the 25 mm, so no weight is recorded.

community.summary: An owner fitted one as a rear after a puncture and rode about 10 km of commuting: it felt more sluggish than a Continental Grand Sport Race; the packaging calls it a wear-focused tire, and the owner saw it for CNY 49 per tire on Taobao.
A short owner video calls it an interesting cheap slick; commenters mention about CNY 20 and marked 25C and 28C wire-bead versions.

availability.note: Listed by a US retailer; owners mention Taobao prices, but no mainland listing was read because the Taobao route stopped at a security check on 2026-11-01.

price_observations.conditions: Regular retailer price on 2026-11-01 for the 25 mm (sale price US$15.99); the page does not tie the price to its single or pair option.

caveats: A heavy-duty entry tire for wear and commuting rather than speed; the retailer weight is inconsistent.
Owners mention a 28 mm wire-bead version, which no maker or shop page confirmed.
